title: SmartShorts & SmartShorts UI
subtitle: Automated Video Generation SaaS (Next.js + Spring Boot)
summary: Automated short and long-form video creation platform powered by AI. Next.js App Router frontend with httpOnly JWT cookies and Java / Spring Boot backend API.
overview: SmartShorts is an innovative SaaS for content creators and marketing agencies that turns simple text prompts into complete videos with narration, images, synchronized subtitles, and soundtrack.
roleDescription: Frontend Architect and Full-Stack Developer during UI modernization and migration from Vite/React to Next.js App Router.
responsibilities: Complete authentication re-architecture: replaced localStorage with server-side Next.js Route Handlers proxying Spring Boot API, storing JWT tokens in httpOnly cookies.
Developed payload translation layer (Adapter Pattern) to convert legacy frontend JSON structures into Java DTOs.
Configured Vitest, React Testing Library, and jsdom test suite.
Created custom hooks like useJobPolling with TypeScript generics.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: 403 Forbidden errors and payload structure mismatch between frontend and Java backend.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Built strongly typed TypeScript adapters ensuring build-time and runtime payload normalization.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: XSS security vulnerability storing JWT tokens in browser localStorage.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Migrated to server-side httpOnly cookies and Next.js Route Handlers acting as an API gateway proxy.

metrics: 100% token security migrated to server-side httpOnly cookies
Real-time video rendering status monitored via reactive polling
